name: Parallel Perspective Shear-Warp Rendering
aliases: Parallel Perspective Shear-Warp Rendering with MPI
definition: A distributed volume rendering technique using Message Passing Interface (MPI) to parallelize the compositing step of the perspective shear-warp algorithm across multiple nodes (shared memory or cluster), where a display machine coordinates the rendering and a remote renderer performs the heavy computation.
summary: Parallel Perspective Shear-Warp Rendering is a distributed volume rendering technique that parallelizes compositing across MPI nodes while requiring every node to hold a full volume copy, partitioning scanlines instead of data.
